data.narrative: Successfully synthesized the full 8-module decomposition and execution planning curriculum, demonstrating tech-lead level maturity. Executed incremental integration across catalog, booking mutex, and payment escrow streams, diagnosed a silent emergent seam defect ('confirmed' vs 'active' status enum mismatch), established a complete 19-requirement traceability matrix, and authored automated cross-component integration test suites.

dimension_scores.observation: Maintained complete chain-of-custody requirements traceability from Module 01 through deployment, honestly identifying and classifying built, simplified, deferred, and lost requirements.
dimension_scores.evidence: Produced artifacts/checklists/module-08-traceability-matrix.md auditing all 19 requirements and proactively uncovering the omission of REQ-12 (2-hour minimum booking notice).

dimension_scores.observation: Sequenced incremental workstream merges in dependency order to isolate failure domains, verifying that each merge preserved upstream interface integrity.
dimension_scores.evidence: Structured merge sequence (Stream A -> Stream B -> Stream C) in artifacts/checklists/integration-module-08.md with boundary smoke assertions.

dimension_scores.observation: Anticipated integration seam failures where components pass unit tests in isolation but fail when integrated, implementing automated CI test gates.
dimension_scores.evidence: Specified INT-TEST-01 through INT-TEST-04 in artifacts/checklists/module-08-integration-test-plan.md targeting high-risk concurrency and delegation seams.

dimension_scores.observation: Authored comprehensive integration test plans with exact prerequisites, step-by-step actions, and measurable boundary acceptance criteria.
dimension_scores.evidence: All 4 test specifications in artifacts/checklists/module-08-integration-test-plan.md define explicit HTTP status codes, payloads, and contract validation points.

dimension_scores.observation: Rapidly diagnosed the silent 'confirmed' vs 'active' status bug without flailing or guessing, providing both an immediate query hotfix and a permanent architectural enum definition.
dimension_scores.evidence: Forensically traced the empty query set in progress/decomposition/module-08/break-diagnosis.md and established BookingStatus enum architecture in progress/decomposition/module-08/fix-integration-bug.md.

dimension_scores.observation: Understood deeply that individual correctness does not guarantee system correctness, designing systemic organizational safeguards to prevent cross-boundary semantic drift.
dimension_scores.evidence: Formulated 4 systemic prevention mechanisms including @skillswap/contracts package, Pact consumer contract testing, and CI OpenAPI diffing.

strengths: Demonstrated exceptional engineering leadership by rigorously auditing requirements traceability across all 8 modules and fearlessly identifying omitted constraints rather than claiming false completeness.

Exhibited advanced architectural judgment by establishing systemic interface governance (Pact consumer contracts, shared enum packages, and incremental merge orders) that prevents multi-million dollar integration catastrophes.
data.recommendation: Deploy these decomposition, planning, and seam-governance practices on complex production initiatives to lead engineering teams and AI agents with high delivery confidence.
